title: UFO Working Group funded by Stubblebine

tellings.quote: Corso stated he learned that in 1986 there was a group created called the UFO working group

we look at the re or look at the manuscript of Corso, it kind of seems like around ' 86 the majestic 12 took on a new name, the UFO working group and got new blood like uh like Albert Stubble and some NSA people
tellings.difference: Says the group was MJ-12 under a new name and adds NSA people, citing Corso's manuscript.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Corso's claim that a UFO Working Group was formed in 1986 and involved Stubblebine.

as_told.title: MJ-12 renamed the UFO Working Group in 1986

plain: In 1986 a secret group called the UFO Working Group was formed in the United States, with backing from the retired Army general Albert Stubblebine. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this comes from Philip J. Corso, a former Army officer who wrote about UFOs, in his manuscript Dawn of a New Age; in a second pass UAPGerb says it looks as if Majestic 12, a supposed secret panel of officials handling UFO matters, simply took the new name and brought in fresh people such as Stubblebine and staff from the National Security Agency, the US code-breaking and surveillance agency. If true, the secret panel lasted decades under different names.
